about.label: About ASSETRA investments
about.title: Specialists in real estate
about.p1: ASSETRA investments is a Slovak investment company specialising in the acquisition, renovation, and sale of undervalued residential properties. We operate exclusively in markets we know thoroughly and focus on opportunities where we can acquire assets significantly below market value.
about.p2: Our team identifies distressed sales, estate liquidations, and motivated sellers. We renovate properties to market standard and sell them at fair market value. This margin — the difference between acquisition costs and the final sale price — is what generates consistent returns for our investors.
about.p3: We do not speculate on market movements. We do not trade financial instruments. We buy real properties, add value, and sell. This straightforward model has proven itself across various market conditions.

portfolio.label: Diversified portfolio
portfolio.description: Our strategy is based on a conservative approach with an emphasis on capital protection and generating stable returns through real assets and proven investment strategies.

realEstate.title: Real Estate & Property Flipping
realEstate.text: We acquire properties below market value through property flipping. We specialise in distressed properties, adding value and subsequently selling them at a significant profit.

loans.title: Secured Loans
loans.text: We finance legal entities and real estate projects through secured loans. We offer flexible terms with an emphasis on investment security and stable, risk-adjusted returns.

equity.title: Acquisitions & Private Equity
equity.text: We seek established, profitable companies in the Slovak and Czech markets suitable for acquisition. We invest through long-term partnerships with a focus on value growth.

cta.heading: Start investing with ASSETRA
cta.text: Fixed 12% annual return paid monthly. Your capital is secured by real assets. Fill out a non-binding form and we will get back to you within 24 hours.

aboutStatement: ASSETRA investments is a private investment company headquartered in Slovakia. We manage a diversified portfolio across real estate, company acquisitions, and secured loans.
